notes.title: 0.4.0 - Baits
notes.content:
Changelog

Added  

 Bait system introduced.
 Players can construct Cherries to distract and guide ants along the field.  
 Cherries have a range of action:  
   
    Ants will target it once they enter this range.  
    Range is very large so players can test and provide feedback on the system.  
   

Changed  

 Ants can now target either constructions or the cake independently.  


Fixed  

 Ants would stop walking in later waves due to flow fields overlapping.

notes.title: Selection Tools
notes.content:
Selection Tools

Multi-Building Selection

Double-click a building to select all buildings of the same type.
Click and drag to select all buildings within a selection rectangle.
Hold Left Control to add buildings to the selection.


Filtering

Click a building counter card in selection mode to filter by building type.


Batch Upgrades

When selecting multiple buildings:
   
   Displays available upgrades for all selected buildings.
   If you have enough currency, upgrades all valid buildings at once.
   


Batch Selling

When selecting multiple buildings:
   
   Displays the total refund value.
   Sells all selected buildings in one action.
